name: Justice
upright: Evidence by the rules: volatile data first, imaged and hashed, logged in an unbroken chain, weighed to the right standard.
reversed: A broken chain of custody, an original altered by its own examiner, and damning evidence the court must throw out.
vision: A judge sits before a purple veil, raising a sword with three edges; every exhibit must survive all three before it reaches the scales. Whoever brushes the veil leaves a thread in it and walks away dusted purple. A neighbors' quarrel tips the scales with one grain of sand, but a prisoner's fate tips only when the pan strikes the floor and casts no shadow. Each exhibit arrives wrapped in a chain whose every link bears a thumbprint and an hour; where one link is missing, the exhibit turns to smoke. A clerk catches the soap bubbles first, then the snowflakes, and leaves the stone tablets for last.
decode: A sword with three edges every exhibit must survive → admissible evidence must be relevant, material and competent (legally obtained).
Brushing the veil leaves a thread and takes purple dust → Locard's exchange principle: every contact leaves a trace and carries one away.
One grain tips the quarrel; the prisoner's pan must strike the floor and cast no shadow → civil: preponderance of the evidence; criminal: beyond a reasonable doubt.
A chain of thumbprints and hours; one missing link turns the exhibit to smoke → chain of custody logs every handler and transfer, or integrity cannot be proven.
Soap bubbles, then snowflakes, then stone → order of volatility: registers, cache and RAM first, then temporary files, then disk, with archives last.
facts: Real evidence is an object (a seized drive); documentary is writing, including logs; testimonial is a witness. The best evidence rule requires the original document, not a copy.
Investigation types: administrative (internal), criminal, civil, regulatory (an agency enforcing its own rules), industry standards. When internal turns criminal, call counsel.
The EDRM: information governance, identification, preservation, collection, processing, review, analysis, production, presentation. A legal hold stops routine deletion.
trap: The collective's oldest sin: examining the original drive. Capture RAM before any shutdown, image the disk bit for bit through a write blocker, hash both, and work only on the copy.
